qualified_scope: Only eight initial massive Euclidean ordinary unit-power N2/N3 rank0/1 cases, batches1/32, COLLIER mode1 versus original IREGI Hybrid; no Rust speed comparison or broader topology/rank qualification.
source_checks: All eight complete-array/pole/UV preflights complete before any timing; timing starts only if every row qualifies.
Every warmup/calibration/measured request checks complete output arrays against its own preflight; each measured pair is additionally compared across engines.

Warmup is five untimed evaluation calls per engine before calibration; warmed single-call result seeds one shared iteration count. Calibration accepts only when both observed blocks reach100ms, uses1.10margin, up to8rounds and maximum1000000iterations.
Five warmup blocks follow calibration, then41paired blocks with a21/20 balanced inventory shuffled reproducibly with seed271828. Timing loops exclude subprocess transport and pole probes.
All eight complete-array/pole/UV postflights occur after the complete cohort and compare back to preflight. Postflight failure marks its row failed and prevents overall passed status.
Paired median ratios use99percent bootstrap confidence intervals and2percent relative width gate. Any measured block shorter than100ms overrides its ratio gate to inconclusive-short-block.
Request waits are bounded by min(120s,remaining900s cohort deadline); exhausted deadlines, iteration caps and incomplete calibration preserve failed rows instead of dropping them.
New output directory is mandatory. Existing correctness receipt must match binaries,input,mode,batches and all producer source hashes; the changed runner has a new matching completed receipt.
Old runner and completed initial receipt are retained with their original source identities; no old receipt is relabeled as current.
limits: Read-only source/hash/JSON/log review; no compiler, tests, numerical kernel or timing launched by reviewer.
900s is a request deadline; final persistence/cleanup and already-started Python bookkeeping can add overhead. Any postflight prevented by expiry fails the cohort.
Large pilot-based duration estimate is planning data only; the fixed cap may yield an honest timeout rather than a performance result.
No performance conclusion until a separately authorized quiet run completes and all statuses/provenance/gates are independently checked.
The readiness count3168 is per engine across pre/post phases; both engines together retain6336complex coefficient values.
